6 /-! Identify every original whole facet in each of the four six-vertex graph forms. -/
7 
8 namespace SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
9 
10 variable {P : ConvexPolyhedron} (graph : P.SixVertexGraph)
11 
12 /-- Each original triangle or quadrilateral is one of the graph's finite polygon candidates. -/
13 theorem facet_is_candidate (F : P.Face)
14     (small : (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
15       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) :
16     F.vertexLabels graph.vertex ∈ graph.kind.candidates := by
17   apply (SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind.isPolygon_iff_candidate _ _).mp
18   rcases small with triangle | quadrilateral
19   · refine Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
20     · rw [F.vertexLabels_card]
21       exact triangle
22     · intro a aF b bF different
23       exact (graph.edges a b).mp (F.adjacent_of_triangle triangle (graph.vertex a) (graph.vertex b)
24         (graph.vertex.injective.ne different) ((F.mem_vertexLabels _ a).mp aF) ((F.mem_vertexLabels _ b).mp bF))
25   · refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
26     · rw [F.vertexLabels_card]
27       exact quadrilateral
28     · intro a aF
29       have count := F.quadrilateral_label_neighbors graph.vertex quadrilateral a aF
30       simpa only [graph.edges, SmallGraphs.SixGraphKind.adjacent] using count
31 
32 /-- The finite list gives exactly the original whole facets of the geometric polyhedron. -/
33 theorem labeledFacets_eq
34     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
35       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) :
36     labeledFacets graph.vertex = graph.kind.facets := by
37   apply graph.kind.facets_determined
38   · intro vertices member
39     obtain ⟨F, rfl⟩ := (mem_labeledFacets graph.vertex vertices).mp member
40     exact graph.facet_is_candidate F (small_faces F)
41   · intro i j adjacent
42     exact labeledFacets_edge_count graph.vertex i j ((graph.edges i j).mpr adjacent)
43   · intro i j different nonedge
44     exact labeledFacets_nonedge_count graph.vertex i j different (fun adjacent => nonedge ((graph.edges i j).mp adjacent))
45 
46 /-- Existence of an original whole facet is equivalent to membership in the explicit facet list. -/
47 theorem exists_facet_iff
48     (small_faces : ∀ F : P.Face, (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 3 ∨
49       (F.val ∩ (P.vertices : Set Space)).ncard = 4) (vertices : Finset (Fin 6)) :
50     (∃ F : P.Face, F.vertexLabels graph.vertex = vertices) ↔ vertices ∈ graph.kind.facets := by
51   rw [← mem_labeledFacets, graph.labeledFacets_eq small_faces]
52 
53 end SixVertexUnfolding.ConvexPolyhedron.SixVertexGraph
